purpose: Concept imagery, not documentation of a real laboratory.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: research laboratory website hero photograph, square 1254 by 1254 composition, highly detailed.
Primary request: Photorealistic editorial concept photograph of all-solid-state battery manufacturing research. In a clean controlled materials science laboratory, show a compact benchtop pellet press with a precisely machined stainless steel cylindrical pellet die below its ram. Nearby on a clean shallow metal tray are a few small, pale ceramic solid-electrolyte pellets and the separate steel punch component. A researcher in a white laboratory coat and blue nitrile gloves carefully handles a pellet with fine tweezers next to the die, conveying real hands-on scientific work. Only gloved hands and forearms are visible.
Composition/framing: Close three-quarter view at workbench height, central press/die and careful hands remain inside the middle 70 percent of the square, center-safe for website hero cropping. Shallow depth of field, softly out-of-focus laboratory/glovebox equipment in background. Coherent, physically plausible press architecture and pellet dimensions. No abstract scientific diagrams.
Lighting/mood: Natural scientific laboratory light, quiet precise research mood.
Color palette: Cool navy and steel blue with restrained teal, realistic polished steel and off-white ceramic textures.
Constraints: Unbranded equipment; no readable text, labels, logos, watermarks, captions or UI. Realistic photographic materials and anatomy, no CGI, no luminous or magical batteries. This is concept imagery, not documentation of a real laboratory.
assets.composition: 1254 × 1254 square. Central stainless-steel compact pellet press and cylindrical die. Blue-gloved hand on left holds one pale ceramic pellet in tweezers above the die; another rests on right. Steel tray at lower left contains four ceramic discs and a separate steel punch. Glovebox windows and circular gloves visible in soft-focus background. No readable text or branding. Primary point of interest around 49% x / 42% y.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: research laboratory website hero photograph, square 1254 by 1254 composition, highly detailed.
Primary request: Photorealistic editorial concept photograph of aqueous rechargeable battery research. On a clean chemistry research bench, a neat transparent glass electrochemical cell holds clear aqueous electrolyte. A fitted nonbranded cap supports distinct slender electrodes reaching into the liquid, with small measurement cables leading to a compact potentiostat in the softly blurred background. A researcher in a white laboratory coat and blue nitrile gloves carefully steadies the glass cell and positions one cable connection above the cap. Only gloved hands and forearms are visible. The liquid surface, glass thickness, electrode placement and cable connections look physically plausible, with clear useful separation between components.
Composition/framing: Close three-quarter view at workbench height, glass cell is the central focal point and the hands stay inside the middle 70 percent of the square, center-safe for website hero cropping. Shallow depth of field with calm, uncluttered laboratory background. An intimate moment of careful measurement setup, real scientific research effort.
Lighting/mood: Natural scientific laboratory light, clean soft reflections in glass and subtle highlights in clear liquid.
Color palette: Cool navy and steel blue with restrained teal, natural transparent glass and metallic electrode textures.
Constraints: Unbranded equipment and no readable displays or labels. No text, logos, captions, watermarks or UI. No flames, sparks, danger or glowing electrolyte. Realistic photographic materials and anatomy, no CGI. This is concept imagery, not documentation of a real laboratory.
assets.composition: 1254 × 1254 square. Transparent cylindrical glass electrochemical cell with clear liquid centered slightly left. White cap supports three visible electrodes and red/black leads; a blue-gloved hand at top right adjusts a lead, another steadies the vessel below right. Bench equipment and small containers soft-focus in background; no readable text or branding. Primary point of interest around 49% x / 54% y.
